verdict: Organic traffic is holding; paid ads are off and GBP engagement dropped sharply.
narrative: This period, all activity came through organic channels — paid advertising on Meta and Google has been completely inactive, generating no spend and no leads. Your Google Business Profile drove 41 actions over the 28 days, but that activity fell 86% in the most recent week, with four consecutive days of zero engagement; we're monitoring this closely and working to restore local visibility. On a brighter note, website sessions rose 28% week over week, meaning people are still finding and visiting your site. The gap to address is conversion: 161 sessions over 28 days produced zero leads, so getting an intake path working on the site is the immediate priority.
